literature_notes: Every ledger line (L1–L8) describes a C-terminal V5 or CFP tag on full-length, membrane-anchored SCN1B. The authoritative topology landmarks place the C-terminus (residues 182–218) in the intracellular compartment. No ledger line reports a tag on the extracellular domain (residues 19–160) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 18). Because the rules require every site to be grounded in a ledger line that reports an insertion on the extracellular face, and no such line exists, the site list is empty. The C-terminal tags are recorded in other_positions as tolerated intracellular insertions.

literature_other_positions.note: CRISPR knock-in V5 tag appended after the last residue (E218) of SCN1B; the C-terminus lies in the intracellular region (182–218) and the tagged protein was successfully immunoprecipitated from brain lysates, confirming tolerance, but the tag faces the cytoplasm.
Full-length SCN1B C-terminal V5 tag in a stable mammalian cell line (β1-V5-2AeGFP-CHL); tolerated and immunodetectable, but the C-terminus is cytoplasmic.
Rat β1 (SCN1B) with CFP fused explicitly to the 'cytoplasmic C-terminus'; full-length membrane-anchored construct confirmed functional, but the tag is intracellular by design.
